name: Hotel La Perla
positioning: Family-run Ladin mountain hotel in Corvara, Val Badia, in the Dolomites, run by the Costa family since its founding in 1956
best_for: Food and wine lovers who want several restaurants and a deep wine cellar under one roof
Travelers who want a family-run house with character and Dolomite views

facts.text: The hotel is in Corvara, in Val Badia, in the Dolomites.
The hotel describes itself as a Ladin house in the Dolomites where traditional warmth meets Tyrolean elegance.
The Costa family has run the hotel generation after generation.
Chef Simone Cantafio cooks at La Stüa de Michil.
The Bistrot Music Club offers international dishes, cocktails and live music.
Ristorante Ladinia is a Ladin osteria with an alpine touch.
In summer, L'Murin becomes a beer hall with an osteria feel, serving simple dishes with evenings in the garden.
Romantik rooms are all different from one another and carry the scent of Swiss stone pine wood.
The top-floor Suite Dolomites has two separate double bedrooms, two bathrooms and two balconies with Dolomite views, for up to six guests.
Suite Ernesto includes its own sauna.

highlights.text: Rooms are furnished with original pieces from the Costa family, such as ceramic cups, headboards, typewriters, paintings, clocks, vases and sculptures.
The Comfort rooms are the oldest in the house; in some, the ceilings came from 17th-century stuben.
Suite Ernesto honors Ernesto Costa, who founded La Perla in 1956.
Les Stües is made up of six unique stuben, and the Mahatma Wine cellar holds fine labels.
Romantik Dolomites rooms look out on the Sassongher, the Sass Ciampac and the Sella group.

considerations.text: The hotel closes between seasons; the official site says it reopens on 4 December.
The hotel calls its spa a small beauty and wellness center.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires travel planning.
